environment: Chrome SwiftShader software GPU; not a phone or hardware-GPU measurement

frames.name: desktop-wide

playback.deviceNote: The achieved ratio is what this device manages. Where it is below 1 the device cannot keep up and nothing is claimed about a speed-up.
playback.meaning: Playback speed only. Each solver step uses the same time step and the native per-edge discharge is still spent per SIMULATED second, so the water's own speed is unchanged; only how much simulated time passes per second of your time has changed.

frames.rendering: fullscreen particle-derived water surface with written fragment depth; the instanced spheres remain as its capture source
frames.composite: fullscreen particle-derived surface with written fragment depth
